messages:
evan (eng-release): Kicking a staged rollout for service: inference-api. Target: 2% -> 15% over 30m. Tag: v1.28.3. Change window confirmed. Please watch latency, error_rate, and KV-cache OOMs. cc @maria (prod-eng) @patrick (pm)

deploy-bot: Rollout started: inference-api v1.28.3 — 2% -> 15% over 30m. Dashboard: <https://deploys/redwood/inference-api/v1.28.3|rollout dashboard>. Canary hosts: 5. Metrics stream: <https://metrics/streams/1747594321>. Autoscaling: on.

sre_oncall: seeing a small p95 bump in eu-west-1 at ~t+6m, about +120ms (82ms -> 205ms). Not visible in other regions yet. Snippet: ```eu-west p95: baseline 82ms -> 205ms```

maria (prod-eng): can we pause at 5% and run a quick heap/kvcache check? last time kvcache warm caused spikes/ooms.

evan (eng-release): pausing at 5% now. deploy-bot, pin rollout and halt further traffic shift.

deploy-bot: Rollout status: PAUSED at 5%. Version pinned: v1.28.3. To rollback: `deploy revert --service inference-api --to v1.28.2`. To resume/advance: `deploy resume --percent=10`.

patrick (pm): we need a rollback decision inside the 15m change window if this persists. Maria — can you reproduce on a mini cluster?

maria (prod-eng): running a small benchmark reproducer now against a 3-node canary cluster, will update in ~8m.

sre_oncall: applying temporary routing fallback to older runtime in eu-west-1 to reduce user impact :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Routing fallback applied to eu-west-1. Alerts suppressed for 10m.

evan (eng-release): thanks. Plan: if Maria reproduces, we roll back. If not, try a kv-cache warm step on canaries and re-evaluate. Decision checkpoint at +20m from thread start.

maria (prod-eng): repro failed locally, looks like cold-start kv-cache variance rather than a code regression. Suggest running a warming job on canaries before advancing. Example: `kubectl exec -c worker -- /opt/warm_kv.sh`

evan (eng-release): ok — run warming on canaries then advance to 10% after 10m. @deploy-bot schedule resume at 10% in 10m unless new signal.

deploy-bot: Scheduled resume: +10m -> advance to 10%. I will post a status update when executed.

patrick (pm): noted. I'll add a note to the release notes about the kv-cache warm requirement and the roll-forward plan.

maria (prod-eng): :thumbsup:

sre_oncall: standing by

evan (eng-release): thanks all, keeping this thread as the decision log.
